title: Change maker
description:
A vending machine has to give change using as few coins as possible. Read an amount in cents (0 to 99) and print how many of each coin to hand back:

```
Quarters: 3
Dimes: 1
Nickels: 0
Pennies: 4
```

That example is for 89 cents: 3 quarters (75), 1 dime (10), 0 nickels, 4 pennies.

| Coin | Worth |
|---|---|
| Quarter | 25 cents |
| Dime | 10 cents |
| Nickel | 5 cents |
| Penny | 1 cent |
hints: Start with the biggest coin. `cents / 25` is how many quarters fit; `cents % 25` is what is still owed afterwards.
Keep shrinking the amount: after quarters, do `cents = cents % 25;` and then work out the dimes from what is left, and so on.
stretch: Extend it to dollar amounts: read cents up to 9999 and also print how many one-dollar coins.
